contract: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple triangle-free graph on vertices 0..22. The score is the least number of edges whose deletion leaves a bipartite graph, computed exactly as edges minus the maximum cut over all 2^22 bipartitions. Maximize; the known optimum is 20.
notes: The finite maximum over triangle-free graphs on 23 vertices is 20 (below the conjectured bound 21.16); recovering it tests constructions near the extremal C5 blow-ups. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.
